description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 tandem-repeat programs ported statement by statement (diagonal-score models, not the exact-run finder find_tandem_repeats). program etandem (default): for every unit size minRepeat..maxRepeat a running per-column consensus score (+1 when the new base is the column's most frequent base, -1 otherwise; N counts as a fifth base, or as a plain -1 with mismatch) extends candidates in steps of the unit size; candidates need a best score >= threshold and, unless uniform, a consensus with two different bases; overlapping candidates lose to the highest score (ties: smaller unit). Reports score, size, count, identity = 100 * (score + n * (copies + 1)) / (2 * n * copies) and the lower-case consensus (phased as printed). program equicktandem: the quick pre-screen - the sequence compared with itself shifted by every gap 1..maxRepeat with a +1 / -1 diagonal score; reported stretches are masked for larger gaps; no consensus / identity. Hits are in the program's report order (etandem: highest score first). Non-ACGT symbols count as N (etandem) / one 'other' class (equicktandem). position is 0-based (EMBOSS Start - 1). Verified against etandem and equicktandem 6.6.0 on 1700 + 1300 random and planted sequences. Input sequences are read as EMBOSS reads them (A4-3, one shared reader): only letters and '*' are kept; gap characters (- . ~ ?), '#', '+', '_', digits, blanks and every other character are dropped first, and positions, lengths and scores count the cleaned sequence (e.g. needle of AC-GTTAGC.TT* and ACGTTAGCTT: score 58, length 11, as the program).

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence: A/C/G/T plus IUPAC codes such as N (case-insensitive).

minRepeat.description: etandem -minrepeat: smallest unit size (>= 2, default 10 as in the program). Ignored by equicktandem.

maxRepeat.description: Largest unit size (-maxrepeat). Default: etandem = minRepeat (as in the program), equicktandem = 600.

mismatch.description: etandem -mismatch: count N as a mismatch instead of a fifth base (default false).

uniform.description: etandem -uniform: also report single-base consensus repeats (default false).

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
Invalid DNA sequence (A/C/G/T and IUPAC codes only)
program must be etandem or equicktandem
minRepeat must be 2 or higher / maxRepeat must be at least minRepeat / threshold must be at least 1 (equicktandem)
